description:
Activate Spara's Headquarters' cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
Bone Miser and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Spara's Headquarters from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spara's Headquarters ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
